mechanism: Ritonavir may inhibit CYP3A4-mediated metabolism and increase zoledronic acid exposure; additive risk of nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes, and calcium levels closely; ensure adequate hydration before zoledronic acid infusion; consider dose adjustment or alternative bisphosphonate if renal function declines.
